people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Aaron, high priest after his father

people.name: Ithamar
people.line: Youngest son of Aaron; served as priest.

people.name: Nadab
people.line: Son of Aaron, consumed by fire for offering incense.

translations.web: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.
translations.bsb: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father did, and they had no sons; so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
translations.kjv: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.
